This branch contains the **entire MESX platform monorepo** — not just the frontend this repo was created for. The separate backend repo wasn't ready in time, so per team instruction the whole platform lives here on `mesx-platform-full` as an interim home.

- **backend** — NestJS 11 + node:sqlite (REST API, auth, data)
